correctness.rationale: In the stated continuous boxcar model, any window receiving positive dose from both pulses contains the intervening gap, so its exposure is ≤ W−g. Thus for g>W−q the mixed response never meets q, leaving exactly the two separate one-pulse superlevels when q≤d and no superlevel otherwise. For q≤d and g≤W−q, if the separate superlevels leave a hole, throughout that hole the first pulse's response falls at unit slope and the second rises at unit slope; their sum is W−g≥q. This yields the claimed outer endpoints. When q>d the two responses are needed; the rising and falling sides imply t≥g+q and t≤W+2d−q by the upper bound d on each single response. On that interval with g≤W−q the sum equals min(2d, W+2d−t, t−g, W−g), hence is at least q. At the critical gap the weak-threshold bridge has equality length q, and the entire strong-threshold superlevel has equality length 2d−q. Inclusion of the equality sets gives both right jumps and both component transitions, including the weak case q=d. Independent exact rational endpoint interpolation agreed in 660 cases near and at the critical gap, retaining even isolated equality points.
residual_risks: The comparison uses ≥ and sharp equal rectangular pulses; this does not establish discontinuities for smoothed pulses, strict thresholds, or operational sampled alerts. Physical scaling by A for a DHW analogue presupposes qualifying contributing HotSpots if compared to the actual NOAA product.

value.rationale: Two rectangular pulses are a motivated controlled test of the difference between unchanged thermal dose and a duration reported by a rolling threshold. The natural outputs are not just the convolution but the separation at which one reported episode splits or vanishes, and the exact loss at that boundary. The weak and strong thresholds have opposite slopes before the jump; this is useful for benchmarking threshold implementations and interpreting this idealized diagnostic. The claim is modest and does not assert new convolution theory or biological prediction.
residual_risks: The exact jumps depend on nonzero equality plateaus; there is no demonstrated operational alert or biological transfer.
